<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex081012026-08-2003-47-00" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person">dur mig pa</rs> na re bab du byed pa myad pa de yang gzhi chon gyi dbang du byas pa ni phung po lnga ste snang pa gzugs kyi gched gzugs kyi phung po kho ba sems kyi gzhi rnam shes kyi phung por 'tshor sems las byung pa'i gzhi tsher ba dang 'du shes ba du byed kyi phyogs 1 gis gnas skabs ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi gzhi 'du byed kyi phyogs 1 gis ston la chos nyid 'dus ma byas kyi gzhi
<lb n="N006"/>
ni phung po nas me ston yang chos kyi khams dang skye mached nas ston na deg la gzni chon ces brjod pa ni gang cag dang chos kyi bdag mod ces dgag pa dang gyur pa 2 rdzas bu yod ces bsgrub pa shes bya dang sngo steng du brtsil se phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
